waiting_period_initial.value: 30 days for all medical and surgical treatments, except for accidents.
waiting_period_initial.clause: A waiting period of thirty (30) days from the commencement date of the policy shall apply to all medical and surgical treatments, except in case of accidental bodily injury occurring during the policy period.

waiting_period_preexisting.value: 36 continuous months of coverage for pre-existing diseases and their complications.
waiting_period_preexisting.clause: Pre-Existing Diseases and their direct complications shall not be covered until thirty-six (36) continuous months of coverage have elapsed since the inception of the first policy.

waiting_period_specific.value: 24 months for specified ailments like cataract, hernia, hydrocele, joint replacement, etc.
waiting_period_specific.clause: Expenses on treatment of the following specified ailments: cataract, benign prostatic hypertrophy, hernia, hydrocele, joint replacement surgeries, and calculus diseases are subject to a mandatory 24-month waiting period from initial inception.
